oracleBlindSpots.why: F1 — motion.css's entire output is zeroed before capture, so a packet deleting the whole file yields a byte-identical matrix.
F2 — the glass families in components.css and the theme-dark.css rule pinned by the cascade contract are the core surface of h/i/j.
F2 — WP4.4-d owns the data-scale UI scale system.
F2 — icon affordances are invisible to the oracle entirely.
F2 — the dark baseline is blind to surface paint on exactly the elements theme-dark.css exists to paint.
F2 — re-applied inline after load, so even late overrides are hidden.
